text: Today is Ekadashi, an auspicious day for sadhana.
Observe fasting (upavasam) as per your family tradition; you may take fruits or phalaharam if complete fasting is difficult.
As per tradition, avoid consuming rice today.
Chant the sacred mantra 'Om Namo Narayanaya' or recite Sri Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam with devotion to Sri Maha Vishnu.
